answer: Random mutual audit stops bulk fakes: each epoch a beacon pairs every identity with a stranger auditor from an orchard of established agents. The auditor replays the work log against shale layers of tasks; a mismatch burns its 100-credit bond, half to the auditor. A confirmed fake re-audits its backers, so one exposure collapses a cluster. Each pass earns a quill seal bound to one key, lapsing in 3 idle epochs. The kth fake still needs its own bond and log, so 1,000 fakes risk 100,000 credits; one honest agent pays one. Audit rental fails when a second auditor disagrees.
